Module com.example.batallanaval
Package com.example.batallanaval.controller

Class PlacementController

java.lang.Object
com.example.batallanaval.controller.PlacementController
public class PlacementController extends Object
Controller for the manual ship placement screen (HU-1). The player drags each ship from the tray onto the position board; ships can be horizontal or vertical and may not overlap or fall off the board. When the whole fleet is placed, the game starts.
